pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding positions into an active drawdown or during high-volatility expansion candles; pyramiding is limited to scale-ins only after a position achieves +$10 floating profit and breaks even.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory order-flow imbalance confirmation combined with a 3-period ATR volatility check; no entry allowed if spread exceeds 30% of average range or within 15 minutes of high-impact news.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing stops once profit reaches +$8.00 and execute tiered profit harvesting starting at +$15.00, prohibiting manual exits under +$5.00.
